unsupported: Urschel Laboratories was founded in 1910 in Valparaiso, Indiana, by William E. Urschel, who invented the Gooseberry Snipper to automate a labor-intensive hand process.
Typical applications range from slicing potatoes and shredding lettuce to pureeing nut milks, milling nut butters, dicing tomatoes, and strip-cutting poultry.
